talk.transcript: Today, I want to talk about renewable energy, which refers to energy sources that are replenished naturally. Common examples include solar, wind, and hydroelectric power. Unlike fossil fuels, renewable energy sources produce little to no pollution and are essential for reducing our carbon footprint. Countries around the world are investing in these technologies to combat climate change and ensure a sustainable future. The transition to renewables can also create jobs and stimulate economic growth, making it a critical area of development.

questions.explain: 可再生能源是指自然補充的能源。
